summary: Learn to assess property climate risk, prioritise capex, design green leases, and guide investment decisions. Explore the course and enrol.
lede: ESG and climate resilience strategy for real estate portfolios training helps asset managers, developers, investors, lenders, and valuers connect climate exposure with income, operating costs, financing, development feasibility, and valuation. You will learn to assess physical and transition risks, measure operational emissions, benchmark asset performance, and prioritise practical resilience measures. Using ISO 31000, the GHG Protocol, CRREM, IFRS S1, IFRS S2, and asset-level evidence, the course turns climate analysis into defensible property decisions. You will practise testing capex options, shaping green lease clauses, mapping tenant responsibilities, building a Power BI or Excel progress dashboard, and translating findings into lending, valuation, and development recommendations.
audienceIntro: This ESG and climate risk course is for professionals who make, review, finance, value, or implement real estate portfolio decisions. It suits intermediate practitioners who can apply their existing property, investment, lending, or facilities experience to structured climate and sustainability actions.
modules: ESG Integration in Finance and Value
Real Estate ESG Reporting and Assurance
ESG and Climate Risk Action Strategy
prerequisites: You should have working experience in real estate asset management, development, investment, lending, valuation, facilities, or sustainability. Familiarity with property financial models, utility data, leases, or investment committee papers will help, but prior climate-risk certification is not required. No coding or programming is required. Advanced concepts such as CRREM pathway interpretation, AI-assisted energy analysis, and climate-adjusted valuation are taught at conceptual and operational application levels, not technical engineering or production deployment levels. Bring a representative asset or portfolio example if permitted by your organisation.
